# Health Dashboard

**Purpose** — entry point for "what is broken". Per [WIKI-RULES](../WIKI-RULES.md) Rule 8 this page carries no
hand-maintained statuses: counts come from the generated machine layer and every status lives in the
findings ledger. The narrative of what changed and why lives in the sprint logs.

## Where the truth is

- **Findings ledger** — `docs/wiki/_machine/findings.json` (generated from `_fragments/*.findings.json`); human view in [Bugs](Bugs.md) and [Security](Security.md).
- **Module registry + graph** — `docs/wiki/_machine/modules.json`, `graph.json`; counts in `manifest.json` (regenerated by `node scripts/wiki/build-machine-map.mjs`).
- **Live status** — the only trustworthy probe is production: `GET https://citation.today/api/health` (database), the adapter registry `src/adapters/index.js` (what is wired), and the quarantine register [_index](../99-Archive/_quarantine/_index.md) (what was removed and why).
- **Last full teardown** — the 2026-09-04 adversarial audit, `docs/audit-2026-09-04/REPORT.md` (120 findings, verified list, roadmap). Its P0/P1 items were closed in v0.46 (`10-Sprints/sprint_log_v0_44.md` §Actuals and the v0.46 commit messages record what shipped).
